channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: La Jolla High cheerleaders capture ‘Game Day’ spirit with CIF title
item.description: La Jolla High School cheerleaders have captured the CIF San Diego Section Game Day Non-Tumbling Small School championship.

item.title: Piano virtuoso Marc-André Hamelin back in San Diego for ‘heroic’ Brahms, Dvořák
item.description: When the San Diego Symphony welcomes über-pianist Marc-André Hamelin’s on Jan. 17 and 18, it’ll be with full knowledge of his versatility as a performer.

item.title: California tax revenue getting a boost from AI boom — but for how long?
item.description: As talk of a possible AI bubble grows, so does uncertainty around an important source of California tax money.

item.title: Will this be the year California makes kindergarten mandatory?
item.description: California is one of 32 states that doesn’t require 5-year-olds to attend school. Proposed legislation may change that.

item.title: Chula Vista motorcyclist killed in collision with state firefighter
item.description: The fatal crash with the motorcyclist took place at about 8:30 a.m. in the 17300 block of state Route 94, in front of Cal Fire Station 30.

item.title: County posts wastewater testing results online; data show rising levels of the flu
item.description: On the dashboard released Wednesday on the county's website, a summary chart breaks down how a virus is circulating in the community.

item.title: Carlsbad declares state of emergency to fast track storm drain repairs near bluffs
item.description: Carlsbad Wednesday proclaimed a storm-related local state of emergency in an attempt to speed the repair of a storm-damaged drain pipe in the coastal bluffs near Carlsbad Boulevard and Solamar Drive.

item.title: Parents of man fatally shot by San Diego police sue city, allege he was surrendering
item.description: The parents of a man who was fatally shot by San Diego police officers filed a wrongful death lawsuit this week against the city and the officers involved, with the lawsuit alleging the man was shot while he was surrendering.

item.title: San Diegans march downtown to protest ICE fatal shooting in Midwest
item.description: In San Diego Wednesday evening, protestors responded to ICE's fatal shooting of a Minnesota woman by marching through Little Italy.

item.title: El Cajon to begin pilot street sweeping program in February
item.description: El Cajon will roll out a six-month pilot program next month intended to improve the effectiveness of street sweeping in specific areas of the city, officials announced Wednesday.
